summary_text: On 2026-05-12 (weekday), the user placed one order of fresh vegetable staples during the night, a timing less common than the population baseline (night share 0.1202 vs. morning 0.3246, afternoon 0.2526, evening 0.3027). The basket included unbranded baby potatoes (280–320 g) and unbranded onions (400–450 g), items typically used for immediate meal preparation. This is a single observation on one date; it is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for these specific items, a preference for night-time ordering, or a one-time need.
